items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: But I didn't know anything of it. But I heard of him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was good too. Do you remember a fella by the name of Zoo Robertson?

And, uh... How did Oak...not Oak...Vick Gaspar. Was he a good one? Vic Gaspar. Was he a good one?
